mutate:duplicateAttributeError.Message: The attribute name trace is used more than once. Message attributes must have unique names.

mutate:fifoNoDedupError.Message: a FIFO queue without content-based deduplication requires $messageDeduplicationId on every new message

mutate:fifoNoGroupError.Message: a FIFO queue requires $messageGroupId on every new message

mutate:receiptExpiredError.Message: This message’s receipt handle may have expired (past its visibility timeout). Poll again before deleting.

mutate:receiptGoneError.Message: This message wasn’t received in the current session, so its receipt handle is gone. Poll again before deleting.
